name: Sync.com
description: Sync.com is a privacy-focused cloud storage platform for securely storing, backing up, and accessing files across devices. Individuals and teams use it to share files and folders, collaborate through team spaces, recover versions and deleted content, and protect documents with end-to-end encryption.
agentUseSummary: Sync.com cannot be connected as an agent provider because its official help center states that API access and third-party integrations are not currently supported.

blocked.label: Connect a Sync.com account
blocked.description: Sync.com does not provide a supported OAuth, account API, or third-party integration for delegated agent access.

blocked.label: Use Sync.com account data
blocked.description: Sync.com officially lists API access as unavailable, so Relay cannot safely read or change a user's files, shares, backups, or team folders.

blocked.label: Run Sync.com agent actions
blocked.description: Relay will not automate the web panel, desktop sync folder, private client protocol, or unsupported third-party access.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported Sync.com API or integration contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No supported Sync.com account API is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No supported Sync.com account API is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Sync.com's official help center lists API access and third-party integrations as features that are not currently supported.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider Sync.com only if the provider publishes a supported account API, OAuth integration, remote MCP service, or written distributable integration contract.

evidence.supports: Sync.com's official help center explicitly lists API access and third-party integrations as commonly requested features that are not currently supported.
Sync.com's official product page describes encrypted storage, backup, file sharing, team collaboration, web access, desktop access, and mobile access, but does not offer a developer account API.
Sync.com's official operating model provides access through its desktop app, mobile app, and web panel rather than a supported third-party account API.
